purpose: Characterize state sufficiency and attempt to falsify a common power-dependent peak explanation; no Task 1.5 acceptance gate
state_selection_rationale: 60 s captures the observed fast coolant overshoot; 120 s is after the initial primary-flow transient; 600 through 7200 s span slower relaxation. Selection uses only existing preconditioning data, not future step responses.
known_early_state_caveat: The 60 s primary-flow reading is an initialization transient; report all eight states and a predeclared sensitivity analysis excluding 60 s.

protocol.state_comparison: save complete FMU state at each time; restore same handle before each branch; verify branch-time observations and inputs match; response = step minus matched control

recorded_observables: all 44 CDU primary supply temperatures C
all 44 CDU primary return temperatures C

candidate_predictors.target_rack_coolant_slope_k_per_min: (T at t minus T at t-20 s) / 20 s times 60 s/min
candidate_predictors.cdu_01_primary_supply_c: CDU 1 primary supply at branch time
candidate_predictors.cdu_01_primary_return_c: CDU 1 primary return at branch time
candidate_predictors.datacenter_primary_flow_gpm: datacenter primary flow at branch time

constant_input_not_a_predictor: rack 1 and all other racks have 10.86 kW current background power at every branch

target_response_metrics.paired_final_increment_c: rack 1 step minus control at 3600 s
target_response_metrics.paired_peak_increment_c: maximum rack 1 step minus control within 0-3600 s
target_response_metrics.paired_time_of_window_max_s: first time of that maximum; 3600 s is right-censored for an eventual peak
target_response_metrics.absolute_step_peak_c: maximum rack 1 temperature in the step branch within 0-3600 s

secondary_response_metrics: CDU 1 primary supply and return paired final, peak, minimum, and times
all 43 neighboring rack coolant paired final and maximum absolute responses
full paired response curves and raw step/control curves
absolute step-branch rack 1 peak and time, for common-peak mechanism check

regression.method: leave-one-state-out ridge regression; predictors standardized within each training fold; intercept unpenalized; fixed alpha 1.0; no hyperparameter selection
regression.report: per-state held-out predictions and signed residuals for every target metric and model; aggregate held-out MAE and maximum absolute error; repeat for seven-state sensitivity excluding t=60 s
regression.interpretation_limit: Eight temporally correlated states on one trajectory cannot identify causal variables or prove sufficiency; models with many correlated predictors are exploratory, and a horizon-bound time of maximum is censored. No p-values or fitted-feature importance claims.

common_peak_check: Report absolute step-branch peak temperatures and times for all states; a narrow peak range with changing peak time is consistent with, but does not prove, a common power-dependent attractor. Material peak variation or incompatible curve shapes weakens that simple account.
decision_rule: No pass/fail threshold; report complete trajectories, effect sizes, repeated-run variation, and residuals whichever way they fall. Do not launch history matching or scheduler comparison from this script.
